title: Pew Pew Pest Control
author: ZakTSK
selftext: I made this game about cleaning kitchens, exterminating roaches, fighting a cult of magical rats,and finger blasting!

comments.author: ZakTSK
comments.body:
It's on google play currently. [pew pew pest control ](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pheasantcouch.pewpewpestcontrol)

I recently had a promo for testers so I can't add one now unfortunately.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/ZakTSK please add details on how AI was used to make this. Just stating that you used AI doesn't pass the rule. The community is a dev community, add dev details. Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion. If you don't update, this post may be removed.

comments.author: ZakTSK
comments.body:
It took me about 2 months and it still has a little bit of work to go. I plan to release on PC soon but currently only on Android. 

One thing I did people may find novel or time wasting was I asked Claude to give me a companion document on how to publish and also how to re-build the game myself step by step.
